gloss: private; not open to the public

definitions.gloss: private; not open to the public; closed
definitions.explanation: Not disclosed or made available to the general public. Used for meetings, information, accounts, and events that are restricted in access.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非公開|ひこうかい}です。
examples.english: This meeting is closed to the public.

examples.japanese: ⟦アカウント→アカウント：05103_akaunto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{非公開|ひこうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I set my account to private.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プライバシー→プライバシー：06806_puraibashii⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{非公開|ひこうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The trial was held behind closed doors to protect the victim's privacy.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧. Very common in modern contexts including social media (private accounts), business (closed meetings), and legal settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非公開|ひこうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make private)
- {非公開|ひこうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (private information)
- {非公開|ひこうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to conduct privately)
- {非公開|ひこうかい}⟦アカウント→アカウント：05103_akaunto⟧ (private account)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧: public, open to the public
